faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Ordnance Factory Itarsi for filling apprentice positions under the Ministry of Defence framework.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The posts available are Graduate Apprentices (General Stream) for eligible candidates holding degrees in various general streams.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in Ordnance Factory Itarsi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 50 vacancies have been announced for the Graduate Apprentices (General Stream) positions in this recruitment cycle.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply through offline mode by downloading the application form, filling it out, and sending it via post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the offline application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed offline application form is 16-10-2026, or within 21 days of employment news publication.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree such as B.Sc, B.Com, BCA, BBA, or BA from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 18 years, and there is no upper age limit specified for these apprentice positions.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary or stipend offered?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 12300/- per month during their one-year practical training period.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for applying?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification, making the application process free of cost for candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification PDF and access the application form directly from the official website munitionsindia.in.
